reasons.text: Because you were forced to be my sister and somehow never escaped.
Because annoying me is apparently your full-time job.
Because you somehow hear me opening snacks from three rooms away.
Because you steal my stuff and then somehow make me feel guilty for asking for it back.
Because your definition of 'I'll be ready in 5 minutes' is scientifically inaccurate.
Because you can start an argument over literally anything.
Because you somehow know exactly how to annoy me in under 10 seconds.
Because you steal food and still ask, 'Are you going to eat that?'
Because you somehow make the house louder just by existing.
Because you have never heard the phrase 'leave my things alone'.
Because you remember embarrassing things about me with terrifying accuracy.
Because you bring up my childhood mistakes like you're presenting evidence in court.
Because you can roast me better than anyone else.
Because somehow your insults are occasionally funnier than my jokes.
Because you have mastered the art of annoying me without saying a word.
Because you borrow my things with the confidence of someone who legally owns them.
Because 'I didn't touch it' usually means you absolutely touched it.
Because you can turn a normal conversation into an argument in record time.
Because you somehow always have a comeback ready.
Because your dramatic reactions deserve their own Netflix series.
Because you can make a tiny problem sound like the end of civilization.
Because you somehow know when I'm hiding food.
Because you never miss an opportunity to expose me.
Because you remember things I desperately wish everyone would forget.
Because you have a special talent for making me regret telling you anything.
Because you can hear gossip from another dimension.
Because you somehow know exactly when I'm lying.
Because your 'I'm not angry' face is absolutely terrifying.
Because you steal the best seat and act like it was reserved.
Because you have never once respected my personal space.
Because you can turn sharing a room into a survival challenge.
Because you somehow make me laugh when I'm trying very hard not to.
Because your laugh is impossible to ignore.
Because you make fun of me and then get offended when I make fun of you.
Because apparently sibling equality means both of us getting roasted.
Because you have stolen at least one thing from me and called it 'sharing'.
Because you somehow always want whatever I'm eating.
Because your timing for asking favors is suspiciously perfect.
Because you can make me say 'fine, whatever' approximately 47 times a day.
Because you know exactly which buttons to press.
Because you press those buttons for entertainment.
Because you somehow survive every argument with me.
Because you have a PhD in irritating your sibling.
Because you can turn a simple family dinner into a comedy show.
Because you make weird noises for absolutely no reason.
Because you somehow make normal photos embarrassing.
Because you have enough embarrassing pictures of me to destroy my reputation.
Because you probably have screenshots I don't even know about.
Because you would absolutely use those screenshots against me.
Because halfway through and somehow I haven't blocked you yet.
Because you somehow manage to be both annoying and entertaining.
Because you make fun of my decisions while making equally questionable ones.
Because your confidence is sometimes completely unsupported by facts.
Because you argue like you're being paid for it.
Because you can turn 'okay' into a 30-minute discussion.
Because you always have something to say.
Because silence around you is apparently illegal.
Because you somehow make every car ride unnecessarily chaotic.
Because you control the music like you own the radio station.
Because you have opinions about things nobody asked about.
Because you give advice like you're a licensed professional.
Because you somehow become a lawyer whenever we're arguing.
Because you remember every word I said five years ago but forget what I told you yesterday.
Because you can detect snacks better than airport security.
Because you somehow appear whenever food arrives.
Because your portion somehow becomes bigger than mine.
Because you call it 'borrowing' even when you've had it for six months.
Because you have absolutely no hesitation exposing me in front of relatives.
Because you know my embarrassing lore better than anyone.
Because you are basically my unpaid personal bully.
Because somehow I'd miss the chaos if you weren't around.
Because the house would probably be suspiciously peaceful without you.
Because you make boring days significantly less boring.
Because you can make me laugh even when I'm annoyed at you.
Because behind every argument is usually something ridiculously stupid.
Because we can go from fighting to laughing like nothing happened.
Because you know when I'm being dramatic because you taught me.
Because you somehow understand my nonsense.
Because our conversations make absolutely no sense to normal people.
Because half our jokes probably require a documentary to explain.
Because you are one of the few people who can roast me and still get away with it.
Because you have seen my worst phases and somehow still claim I'm your brother.
Because you've witnessed enough of my stupidity to write a whole biography.
Because you somehow survived growing up with me.
Because I somehow survived growing up with you.
Because we have enough childhood memories to blackmail each other forever.
Because even when you annoy me, you're still the person I'd defend instantly.
Because you're my emergency contact for problems I probably caused myself.
Because you're the first person I'd call when something completely stupid happens.
Because life would be way too quiet without your nonsense.
Because nobody can replace my personal source of daily irritation.
Because you're annoying enough to be unforgettable.
Because you're weird, but unfortunately you're my kind of weird.
Because you're basically my childhood permanently attached to my life.
Because no matter how much we fight, you're still stuck with me.
Because having you as my sister is honestly pretty lucky.
Because underneath all the roasting, I genuinely care about you.
Because you're one of the few people I can be completely stupid around.
Because after all these years, you're still my favorite person to annoy.

I could give you 100 reasons...
But honestly,
You're my sister.
Unfortunately, you're stuck with me forever. ❤️😂
